Tripleseat provides a platform for hospitality businesses to manage group sales, banquet, catering, and event operations. The Software Engineer 1 will deliver scoped features, bug fixes, and product enhancements using both traditional and AI-assisted development while testing and owning the quality of the resulting code. The role also involves reviewing AI-generated code, debugging, writing maintainable backend and frontend code, and collaborating with the engineering team.
Lifestyle
Telecom & Communications
Software
Event Management
Internet
Work & Life Balance
No H1B
Responsibilities
Deliver clearly scoped features, bug fixes, and product enhancements by combining code you write yourself with AI agent-assisted development, owning the quality of the result either way
Build strong technical fundamentals across our stack so you can critically evaluate AI-generated code rather than assuming that clean-looking output is correct
Learn how to give AI agents the context they need—including clear requirements, relevant examples, constraints, and system context—to produce useful results
Practice spec-driven development by clearly defining intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria before implementation so a teammate, an AI agent, or your future self can understand exactly what needs to be built
Review AI-generated code critically for subtle failure modes, including missed edge cases, misunderstood requirements, incorrect assumptions, and violations of established system behavior
Write clean, maintainable, and testable backend and frontend code that follows existing engineering patterns and conventions, and be able to explain why your implementation satisfies the requirements
Build independent debugging and engineering judgment by intentionally completing some work without AI assistance and developing the hands-on instincts required to diagnose problems yourself
Experiment regularly with new AI development tools and workflows, learning where they accelerate engineering work and where human judgment remains essential
Communicate progress, blockers, technical decisions, and lessons learned with your team, including where AI assistance was used and what your review process identified
Develop an understanding of Tripleseat's customers and business workflows so you can connect the software you build to real customer outcomes and recognize when a problem is—or is not—well suited to AI assistance

Required
0–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience through internships, co-ops, coursework, hackathons, or substantial personal projects
Strong computer science fundamentals, including programming, data structures, algorithms, and basic system architecture
Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools beyond basic autocomplete
You are comfortable prompting, reviewing, debugging, and challenging AI-generated code rather than accepting it at face value
Curiosity about what AI genuinely does well and where it struggles, with an interest in developing your own understanding of which engineering tasks are appropriate for agent-assisted development
Some experience writing structured requirements, specifications, or acceptance criteria that another person—or an AI agent—could execute against
A quality-first mindset and working understanding of unit testing across backend and frontend development
Ability to work within a large, established codebase, follow existing conventions, and ask thoughtful questions when requirements or system behavior are unclear
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively in a remote-first environment
Genuine enthusiasm for AI-assisted software development combined with the rigor and skepticism to verify its work every time
eligible to work in the United States or Canada
Preferred
Personal, academic, internship, or professional projects involving agent frameworks, LLM APIs, autonomous coding tools, or other AI-assisted development workflows
Familiarity with Ruby on Rails, React, MySQL, or PostgreSQL
Familiarity with AWS, DevOps practices, or cloud infrastructure
Experience with or enthusiasm for hospitality technology, event management, restaurants, hotels, or other operational SaaS products
Benefits
Fully remote position open to candidates eligible to work in the United States or Canada, with initial onboarding onsite at the Concord, MA office.
Competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to support health and well-being.
Company Paid Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability Plans: Protection and peace of mind in unforeseen circumstances.
Supplemental Insurance Options: Optional critical illness, accident, and hospital plans.
Commuter Benefits: Transit and parking benefits, where applicable.
401(k) with Company Match: Helping employees save and plan for retirement.
Parental Leave: Support for new parents through birth, adoption, or foster care.
Flexible Paid Time Off: Encouraging work-life harmony and balance.
LinkedIn Learning Access: On-demand professional development courses.
Pet Insurance: Supporting the well-being of furry family members.
Employee Discount Programs: Exclusive savings through employee perk platforms.
